summary: Checkpoint authenticated: commit 22917252 carries tree 3bbf0091 with parent 2b3080d6, a valid GPG signature (Faolain, key 761B99CEA81C6289), and a plan-only diff (production-hardening-tdd-plan-v2.md plus .logs evidence). All source claims in the D.110c-0b0b section verified against local production code. (1) Gap is real: openCurrentAnchorTrust enforces currentEpoch===0 and pinned-genesis digest equality (packages/protocol-v3/src/index.ts:1438-1452); openCreatorSuccessorTrust requires an already-held predecessor capability and epoch exactly +1 (packages/protocol-v3/src/creator-close.ts:559-643); CurrentAnchorTrust minting is WeakMap-custody private to protocol-v3 (index.ts:828-846, creatorAnchorTrustSuccessorMinter internal symbol); inspectCreatorTrustAdvance's exactCombinedClosure retains every current ref except the old trust and adds the successor trust plus both proof refs, so CutValue/QC pairs accumulate O(N) (packages/control-plane/src/creator-trust-advance.ts:88-99). (2) The frozen openCreatorCheckpointTrust contract is complete and non-circular: it binds the pinned genesis capability, byte-identical profile/signer-set carriers, both creator signatures, exact adjacent epochs, previousAnchor lineage, current CutValue/commit QC, successor derivation, and a caller-copied expected tuple, returns only the current trust, and takes no store/AHE input. (3) Requiring the immediate predecessor record is justified under the fixed-creator model: it authenticates the previousAnchor link against held bytes and supplies the QC authority context; its availability obligation is bounded by the two-generation Superseded law and fails closed, so it is not circular, unsafe, or incompatible. (4) inspectBoundedCreatorTrustAdvance's retire/install semantics are deterministic and match the existing exactCombinedClosure idiom, with fail-closed handling of omission, substitution, duplication, extra deletion, and retained retiring refs. (5) The two-complete-Superseded rollback law keeps the epoch-(N-1) record available for every epoch-N reopen and gates deletion behind authenticated install, floor commit, and D.109 gates; crashes retain too much, never too little. (6) Freshness honesty is preserved: the 0b0 floor remains the sole latestness authority, stale-but-authentic checkpoints are rejected via the expected tuple, and brand-new-client floor delivery stays Phase 7. (7) Scope is clean: two non-root subpath exports follow the existing convention (protocol-v3 ./creator-close, control-plane ./creator-trust-advance), reuse the v1 schema, and add no wire/authority/dependency/threshold/migration change; root exports and the package smoke-test forbidden list remain untouched. (8) TDD causality is correct: design acceptance is sequenced after 0b0 RED/GREEN and before a/b production edits; 0b1 RED consumes the genuine 0→1→2 path and never fixture-mints epoch 2. (9) Adversarial/retained gates, the 100-transition census deferred to D.110c-d, archive separation, and restart boundaries are explicitly owned. (10) Hedera comparison verified: hip and crypto clones sit at the pinned commits, and all six newly recorded consensus blob hashes (V0730HistorySchema, WrapsMpcStateMachine, ProofControllerImpl, RosterTransitionWeights, TssConfig, DefaultSignedStateValidator) match files at the audited head 1aa1d6c1, consistent with the byte-identical refresh claim; the WRAPS characterization (genesis-descent lineage, not latestness) remains correctly limited.
